notes: Group 2: 12 files, 197 total series records (168 unique series_ids). | Duplicate series_ids across files: 29 IDs appear in both MoneySupply_M1M2 and M2components_Monthly — these are near-identical M2 component files from the same Bank Indonesia source; the M2components file adds BM(M2) Narrow Money+ (M1+) not present in MoneySupply_M1M2. | IPI file mixes monthly P1M sector indices (23 series) with quarterly P3M sub-indices (6 series, subset of sectors) plus 1 Bank Indonesia Prompt Manufacturing Index (P3M, % unit vs 2010=100) — kept all, subcategory distinguishes. | ForeignExchangeReserves: two World Bank 'Months of Import' series (P1M and P1Y) for the same concept from different sources/frequencies — kept both; unit is 'Month' from WB vs 'NA' for CEIC. | GovernmentDebt: World Bank series in IDR mn (P3M quarterly); CEIC series annual USD/% GDP — all plausibly id_government_debt_borrowing. | Unemployment file includes province-level annual rates (7 provinces: DKI Jakarta, West Java, Central Java, East Java, DI Yogyakarta, Banten, Central Sulawesi), by-age-group, by-education-level unemployment counts — all kept, subcategory marks province context. | CLI file: CEIC proprietary leading indicator + OECD CLI components; unit 'NA' for index levels is expected for composite CLI series. | CorporateBondMarket: multi-source (BI, OJK, Cbonds) measuring same outstanding corporate bonds — units vary (IDR tn vs IDR bn vs NA for count); flagged as near-duplicate conceptual coverage. | Category overrides applied: IPI_byManufacturingSector placed in id_industrial_production_utilization (file in 01_RealActivity matches guide); LeadingIndicator_CLI placed in id_cyclical_activity_indices per TAXONOMY guide.
